title: Workflow Manifest (schema_version 1)
description: One Workflow in the workflow-manager Istari system: what to collect from the user and what to run. Human-readable specification: docs/manifest-schema.md. Readers ignore unknown fields, so additionalProperties is left open throughout. Cross-reference rules (unique keys, binding resolution, function.target naming a resource input) are enforced by the validator, not by this schema. The non-standard `errorMessage` keyword carries the human-readable message a validator should emit when the annotated subschema fails.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. "1" for this document. Readers reject unknown major versions.

key.description: Stable identifier, kebab-case, unique within the system. Used in routes and run documents.
key.errorMessage: key must be kebab-case (lowercase letters, digits, single hyphens)

description.description: One or two sentences shown on the catalog card.

version.description: Semver. Recorded on every run so history survives manifest changes.
version.errorMessage: version must be semver, for example "1.0.0"

icon.description: Name from the SPA's icon set.

identifier.description: Key referenced from bindings. Must not contain dots, whitespace, or "$" so that dotted binding paths stay unambiguous.
identifier.errorMessage: key must contain only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens

stage.description: One step of the workflow. With a function: job stage. Without a function but with inputs: review gate. Neither: display stage.

key.description: Unique within the manifest. Referenced by later stages as $stages.<key>.

inputs.description: Fields collected from the user at this stage.

function.description: Module Function to run after inputs are submitted.

outputs.description: What the function produces, so later stages and views can bind to it.

view.description: How to present this stage's content (review gate or result display).

then.description: An Istari job runs against exactly one resource, so a job stage needs a resource input to be its target.

inputs.errorMessage: a stage with a function must have at least one "resource" input to use as function.target

then.errorMessage: a stage with a function must declare inputs including at least one "resource" input

inputType.description: Each type maps to exactly one React component.

optionsBy.description: Dependent options: show the group whose key matches the resolved `source` value, exactly (default) or as a case-insensitive substring of the value when `match` is "contains". `source` must bind to another input in the same stage.

source.description: Binding to an input in the same stage, for example $inputs.llm_credential.name.

groups.description: Option list per possible source value.

match.description: How group keys are compared with the source value: "exact" (default) or "contains" (first key found as a case-insensitive substring of the value).

filter.description: Type-specific constraints. Which fields apply depends on the input type; unrelated fields are ignored.

system.description: resource, branch: binding to a `system` input that scopes the picker. Required for branch.

secret_type.description: auth_secret: optional. Restrict the picker to credentials whose auth type matches, given as an Istari validation type ("@token:llm" matches auth type token) or an auth type (token, basic, oauth). Omit to list every linked account credential.

pattern.description: text: regular expression the value must match.

min.description: number: minimum value. multi_enum: minimum number of selections.

max.description: number: maximum value. multi_enum: maximum number of selections.

options_by.description: enum, multi_enum: options that depend on another input in the same stage.

source.description: stage_output: binding to an earlier stage's output, $stages.<stage>.outputs.<key>. Required.
source.errorMessage: must reference an earlier stage's output ($stages.<stage>.outputs.<key>)

input.description: A field collected from the user. Referenced as $inputs.<key>.

secret.description: If true the value is never written to the run document. Only auth_secret and text may set it.

component.description: Custom component compiled into the SPA. Overrides the default for `type`.

filter.errorMessage: enum and multi_enum require exactly one of "options" or "options_by"

then.errorMessage: enum and multi_enum require a filter with exactly one of "options" or "options_by"
stage_output requires a filter with source ($stages.<stage>.outputs.<key>)

filter.errorMessage: branch requires filter.system ($inputs.<key> of a system input)

then.errorMessage: branch requires a filter with system ($inputs.<key> of a system input)

type.errorMessage: secret may only be set on auth_secret and text inputs

function.description: Module Function to run against the target resource.

name.description: Fully qualified function name, for example @istari_utils:smart_diff, or a binding (for example $inputs.model) to an enum or text input whose value is the function name at runtime.
name.errorMessage: function name must be fully qualified (for example "@istari_utils:smart_diff") or a binding such as "$inputs.model"

version.description: Function version. Omit for latest. Pin in production.

target.description: Key of a `resource` input in this stage. Its resource_id becomes the job's resource_id.

parameters.description: Function parameter name to a binding or literal.

sources.description: Additional user_model inputs: function input key -> binding to a `resource` input, or to an earlier stage's input/output. The bound value's revision_id is sent as a job source with that relationship identifier.

propertyNames.errorMessage: function input keys must be non-empty

auth_bindings.description: auth_info inputs: function auth input key -> binding to an `auth_secret` input; its secret_id is bound to the job.

propertyNames.errorMessage: function input keys must be non-empty

output.description: Something the function writes to /stages/<key>/outputs in the run document. Referenced as $stages.<stage>.outputs.<key>.

path.description: For json: pointer into the run document section the module wrote, when the output is nested.

view.description: How to present a stage's content.

source.description: Binding to the content to show, usually $stages.<key>.outputs or one output within it.
